role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 末日使者总有手段终结敌人。他吞噬生物并获得他们生前的各种技能，他的终极技能让敌人对自己的技能和物品望之兴叹，随之被魔火烧成灰烬。
hero_summary_en: One way or another, Doom shuts down his enemies. Devouring creeps to claim the various skills they had in life, he can place a lingering silence upon a foe's spells and items with his ultimate as he torches his foes.

abilities.name: doom_bringer_devour
abilities.description_zh: 消化一个敌军或中立生物，获得其特殊技能。开启多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，末日使者不会获得其技能。持续时间与冷却时间相同。
abilities.description_en: Consumes an enemy or neutral creep, acquiring any special abilities that it possessed. If alt-cast is activated, Doom will not acquire the creep's abilities. Duration is equal to the cooldown.
notes_zh: 末日使者将获得该生物的正常金钱，还有技能的额外金钱。
如果吞噬的单位没有技能，之前获得的技能将会保留。
notes_en: Gives Doom the original bounty of the creep, along with the bonus gold.
If you devour a creep without abilities, you'll keep the abilities you had previously.

shard_loc.en: Devour has %AbilityCharges% charges and can target Ancients. Stolen creep abilities have %bonus_aoe_pct%%% increased AoE and %bonus_spell_amp_pct%%% increased spell amplification.
shard_loc.zh: 吞噬拥有%AbilityCharges%点能量点数，能以远古生物为目标。获得的野怪技能拥有%bonus_aoe_pct%%%额外作用范围和%bonus_spell_amp_pct%%%额外技能增强。

abilities.name: doom_bringer_scorched_earth
abilities.description_zh: 用火焰覆盖周围的土地，对敌人造成伤害，同时末日使者的移动速度和生命恢复得到提升。
abilities.description_en: Carpets the nearby earth in flames which damage enemies, while also granting Doom increased movement speed and health regeneration.
notes_zh: 焦土会跟随末日使者，以他所在位置为中心。
notes_en: Scorched Earth follows Doom, centered on his location.

abilities.name: doom_bringer_infernal_blade
abilities.description_zh: 末日挥舞他的炽烈之剑，将敌人点燃。造成%ministun_duration%秒眩晕，并施加一个燃烧效果，持续%burn_duration%秒，每秒造成伤害，数值为基础伤害+目标最大生命值的一定百分比。
abilities.description_en: Doom swings his burning sword, igniting the enemy. Stuns for %ministun_duration% seconds and applies a %burn_duration% second burn that deals a base damage plus a percentage of the target's Max HP as damage per second.
notes_zh: 可以打断持续施法类技能。

abilities.name: doom_bringer_doom
abilities.description_zh:
对敌人施加末日诅咒，对其进行驱散，并且使其无法施放技能或获得任何治疗效果，同时造成持续伤害。

驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en:
Inflicts a curse that dispels an enemy and prevents them from casting spells or healing in any way, while taking damage over time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

scepter_loc.en: Doom applies Break to enemies. Allies in a %scepter_aura_radius% radius around the doomed target also suffer the effects of Doom. Allows Doom to be self-cast to affect enemies around himself with Doom.
scepter_loc.zh: 末日对敌人施加破坏效果。末日作用下目标%scepter_aura_radius%范围内友军也会受到末日的作用。可以对自身施放末日，使末日作用于末日使者周围的敌人。

facet_text_en: Every %upgrade_interval% minutes, Doom's duration is increased by %upgrade_amount%s.
facet_text_zh: 末日的持续时间每%upgrade_interval%分钟都会提升%upgrade_amount%秒。

abilities.name: doom_bringer_lvl_pain
abilities.description_zh: 末日使者的攻击会诅咒敌方英雄。%damage_debuff_duration%秒后，被诅咒的英雄会爆发出一根火柱，对自身和%spread_radius%范围内所有敌方单位造成伤害，伤害量为诅咒期间内承受来自末日使者的%bonus_damage_pct_base%%%伤害。如果被诅咒的英雄等级为%level_multiplier%的倍数，诅咒的伤害和作用范围会提升%bonus_at_level_pct%%%。
abilities.description_en: Doom's attacks curse enemy heroes. After %damage_debuff_duration%s, the cursed hero bursts with a pillar of fire, damaging itself and all units in a %spread_radius% AoE for %bonus_damage_pct_base%%% of the damage taken from Doom during the curse. The damage and radius of the curse is %bonus_at_level_pct%%% stronger if the enemy's level is a multiple of %level_multiplier%.
notes_zh: 末日使者达到满级后也会生效。
notes_en: Also applies to all attacks when Doom is at max level.
